name: input
title: Input
description: Text field with a label, hint, and error message wired up through ARIA.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text, linked to the input through for and id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint text below the input. Hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Turns on aria-invalid and the danger border.

props.name: id
props.description: Input id. Generated automatically when empty.

props.name: type
props.description: Native type attribute (email, password, and so on).

props.name: value / v-model / bind:value / [(value)]
props.description: Current text. Blade and Astro use the value attribute, React value or defaultValue, Vue v-model, Svelte bind:value, Angular value or [(value)].

a11y: The label is linked to the input through the for and id attributes.
Screen readers announce the error and hint through aria-describedby.
aria-invalid is set when the error prop is filled.

ai.whenToUse: Single-line text fields in forms: name, email, password, search.
rules: Always set a label, never rely on the placeholder alone
Pass server validation messages to the error prop

id.description: Kolom teks dengan label, petunjuk, dan pesan error yang terhubung lewat ARIA.

props.label: Teks label yang terhubung ke input lewat for/id.
props.hint: Teks petunjuk di bawah input. Disembunyikan saat ada error.
props.error: Pesan error. Mengaktifkan aria-invalid dan border danger.
props.id: Id input. Dibuat otomatis kalau kosong.
props.type: Atribut type native (email, password, dan seterusnya).
props.value / v-model / bind:value / [(value)]: Teks saat ini. Blade dan Astro memakai atribut value, React value atau defaultValue, Vue v-model, Svelte bind:value, Angular value atau [(value)].

a11y: Label terhubung ke input lewat atribut for dan id.
Pesan error dan petunjuk dibacakan screen reader lewat aria-describedby.
aria-invalid aktif saat prop error terisi.

ai.whenToUse: Input teks satu baris di form: nama, email, kata sandi, pencarian.
rules: Selalu isi label, jangan hanya placeholder
Teruskan pesan validasi server ke prop error
